activity_summary: You paid sixpence for the firing and the washing. It is the first coin, from today to Lady Day. You did not buy ink. You ate a mouthful and kept the hour for Shoreditch.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Paid the sixpence, took a mouthful, and named nine at Shoreditch.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Named the first coin, and kept the sixpence where she could see it.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Had the linen off, and asked whether he would eat.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: This is the first coin of the winter, and it runs to Lady Day.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I must be at Shoreditch by nine.
